questions.question: Explain the difference between heat and temperature.

explanation.text: Heat is energy transferred between bodies because of a temperature difference, while temperature is a measure related to the average kinetic energy of particles in a substance.
Thermal equilibrium occurs when bodies in thermal contact reach the same temperature and there is no net transfer of thermal energy between them.

questions.question: Explain the meaning of specific heat capacity.

explanation.text: Specific heat capacity is the quantity of heat energy required to raise the temperature of one unit mass of a substance by one degree Celsius or one kelvin.
